text.en: A child's attachment style is fixed permanently by infancy and cannot meaningfully change afterward -- in reality, attachment style is a probabilistic tendency shaped by the earliest caregiver relationship, but it can and does shift in response to significant later relationships and experiences, not a single unchangeable sentence handed down in infancy.
text.et: Lapse kiindumusstiil on jäädavalt fikseeritud imikueas ega saa hiljem sisuliselt muutuda -- tegelikult on kiindumusstiil tõenäosuslik kalduvus, mida kujundab varaseim hooldajaga suhe, kuid see saab ja ka muutub vastusena olulistele hilisematele suhetele ja kogemustele, mitte üksainus muutumatu saatus, mis on imikueas määratud.
